questions.question: At Recreation Ground, who holds the record for 'Most Runs' (List A)?
Which bowler holds the second-most 5-wicket hauls in this database's history (9), and was still playing in the 2025/26 season, over 20 years after her database debut?
questions.explanation: Jana Nell has taken 9 five-wicket hauls across 190 matches (2005 to 2026), second only to Susan Benade's 11.

questions.question: Susan Benade set a database record (combined T20 + List A) with a value of 119. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Matches as Captain', held by Susan Benade.

questions.question: At which ground did Knights record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Bloemfontein Oval — largest win by runs of 136, against Kei on 2018/11/25.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Kei or Badgers?
At which ground did Tumi Sekhukhune record their career-best bowling figures (4-20, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Wanderers, against Cobras on 2023/04/02.
